column1: # Pinned competitor libraries and checkouts for competitors/setup.sh (spec §8.2–8.7).
# Toolchain pins (Rust channel, oha, wrk, .NET channel, version floors) live at the top of setup.sh.
#   vendorlock  source = name in vendor/manifest.tsv; the commit is that suite's <name>.lock
#               (the existing pins, spec §8.2 — not duplicated here; pin/check are "-")
#   git         source = clone URL; pin = tag or branch; check = the commit it resolved to
#   jar         source = Maven Central path; pin = version; check = sha256 of the jar
#   tarball     source = URL; pin = version; check = sha256 of the tarball
# Everything is fetched into competitors/third_party/ (gitignored); nothing here is built.
# --- device reference suites (§6.13, §8.3): fetched only, never built here ---
# --- Java jars (Maven Central, transitive closure as resolved by Maven 3.8.7 on 2026-10-25) ---
# Jackson stays at the vendor/jackson.lock versions (2.22.0 / 2.22); setup.sh cross-checks.
